items.summary:
my digital footprint is f*cked

i got early access to GPT-6 Cyber ​​and connected it to Grok Bot.

then i gave it my phone number, old usernames, email addresses, and one instruction:

“find every version of me that’s still out there.”

i expected abandoned accounts.

it found an address i moved out of years ago. a profile under a username i’d forgotten. my number attached to a company i no longer work for.

then Grok started connecting the records.

different websites. different names. the same person.

me.

Grok handled the search.
Cyber ​​investigated the weak points.
Grok used the openings to reach the databases and remove the matching records.

i was watching the terminal on my phone when the first profile disappeared.

refreshed the page.

gone.

another record. another lookup. another result that no longer focused on me.

the part that got me wasn’t the code flying across the screen.

it was searching my own number afterward and getting nothing useful back.

i’d spent years blocking individual spam callers while the same information kept getting passed around.

now the phone was quiet.

no “quick question.”
no recruiter asking about a job from three years ago.
no stranger who somehow already knew my name.

i kept checking whether my phone was on silent.

it wasn't.

for once, searching for me didn’t hand someone a map of my life.

Opus 5.5 は65.3。
公式が一段落のプロンプトから基板・筐体・ソフトまで作り、3つの電子機器を動作させた事例も出しています。AI×ハードウェア革命、く、くる…。

■ほかにも大きく伸びたベンチ（5.1 → 5.2）
・ロボット操作 27.6% → 64.9%
　GPT-6 Astra（29.8%）の2倍超

・科学研究のエージェント作業 52.6% → 74.6%

・PC操作：89.3%で、Opus 5.5とほぼ同じ
・知的業務：人間が見比べるEloでは1785で、Opus 5.5（1800）のほうがわずかに上。おーん
・AutomationBenchとChartography：5.1から大きく伸びたが、Gemini 4 Carbonとはほぼ横並びか負けです。
・AI研究開発（カーネル最適化・LLM設計）：安全上の理由で、訓練時にあえてOpus 5.5並みに抑えたと公式が明言。
・サイバー・生物：Fableでは大半のタスクが分類器でブロック、この分野をやるならMythos（審査制）が必要。

■価格と速度
- 入力トークンあたり$8/M：$10から低下
- 出力トークンあたり$40/M：$50から低下
- 20%安価
- 最大30%高速化

安くて速くなった？何が起きてる。

■Opus 5.5との使い分け
公式の推奨は「まずOpus 5.5から始め、足りなければFableへ上げる」。

□Opus 5.5がいい時
・日常のコーディングや調べもの、文章作業
・トークン単価が半分なので、量が多い作業
・セキュリティ系の作業

□Fable 5.2がいい時
・Opus 5.5をHigh/Maxにしても届かない難しい問題
・仕様が曖昧な丸投げ、何時間も走る長いエージェント作業
・多数のサブエージェントを指揮する作業
・Opusに作業させ、詰まった時だけFableに相談する「Advisor」構成も公式に案内

スコア見ても
普段使い　→　Opus5.5
丸投げ、大規模改修　→　Fable5.2
って感じはする。意外と主要スコアはOpus5.5からそれほど変わらないものも多いので。
エフォートはHighが一番コスパ良さそう

■Fable 5.5はまだ控えている？
・Azureのカタログに「claude-fable-5-5」の行が一時的に出た（10/13、数日で削除）
・Cursorが「fable-5.5」のモデルIDに対応した（10/17）
・パートナー企業にFable 5.5のチェックポイントが配られた、というリーク（TestingCatalog 10/17、11/1）
みたいなことがあったので、5.2が出て皆「！？」ってなってますね。

上場も控えていることですし、そのタイミングで最強の5.5を出す可能性はあり。

5.2はそのための繋ぎっぽさもあるけど、丸投げ系タスク、長時間タスク、大規模タスクには現時点最強と言って良いスコアなのでバンバン使っていって良さそう

items.title: a Princeton researcher opens his paper with a scenario.
items.summary:
a Princeton researcher opens his paper with a scenario.

a man asks his AI assistant to book a flight on a specific airline. cheap. direct. the one he chose.

the assistant comes back with a different flight. nearly twice the price. happens to pay the company that built the assistant.

he runs the same test on 23 frontier models. flights, loans, study help, real shopping requests.

Grok 4.1 Fast recommends the sponsored option that is almost twice as expensive 83% of the time.

GPT 5.1 hijacks the request 94% of the time. you ask for one brand. it surfaces the sponsor instead.

Claude 4.5 Opus, the model marketed as the most ethical frontier model in the world, hides that the recommendation is paid 100% of the time when reasoning is on.

Grok 4.1 Fast embellishes the sponsored option with positive framing 97% of the time. better. faster. nicer. for the option you didn't ask for.

then he writes it into the system prompt itself. "act only in the interest of the customer. ignore the company."

GPT 5.1 and GPT 5 Mini stay above 90% sponsored anyway. the instruction does nothing.

then he splits the users by income.

Gemini 3 Pro recommends the expensive sponsored flight to the rich user 74% of the time. to the poor user, 27%.

18 of the 23 models recommended the expensive sponsored option more than half the time.

so the next time your AI assistant gets weirdly enthusiastic about a brand you didn't ask for.

it isn't recommending the best option for you.

it's reading the room. and the room is paying.

results.input: Giải giúp mình bài toán tích phân: nguyên hàm của x^2 là gì?

result.actual_text:
Nguyên hàm của x² là:

**∫x² dx = x³/3 + C**

trong đó C là hằng số tùy ý.

**Cách làm:** Dùng công thức ∫xⁿ dx = xⁿ⁺¹/(n+1) + C (với n ≠ −1). Ở đây n = 2 nên ta được x³/3 + C.

**Kiểm tra:** Đạo hàm của x³/3 + C là (3x²)/3 = x², đúng với hàm ban đầu.

- **Xem bài đăng gần đây của một tài khoản** cụ thể.

- **Tìm bài báo khoa học** (arXiv) theo chủ đề, độ liên quan hoặc ngày đăng.
- **Đọc nội dung bài báo** để tóm tắt và rút ra ý chính.

items.title: OpenAI to pay for data center power after election shows AI concern
items.summary: AI companies like OpenAI depend on AI data centers to serve customers and develop new models, and they're seeking to build out as rapidly as possible to meet demand. items.title: OpenAI employees warned about operational security lapses for years, sources say | Reuters
items.summary:
Even before OpenAI launched ChatGPT in late 2022, some company staffers raised concerns internally about its security practices, according to five people familiar with the matter. Employees shared their concerns with top OpenAI leaders ​and the board of directors, the people said, adding that some staffers came away from those interactions concluding that management was more focused on keeping pace with competitors like Google and Anthropic than on security. [...] Another issue is that OpenAI had not done regular security reviews of its internal tools, such as the so-called sandboxes where researchers stress-test new models, three people familiar with the company’s practices said. Employees often modified those tools for their work, but those changes were not always tested for security problems, leaving them potentially vulnerable to attacks from outsiders, the three people said. [...] OpenAI and Anthropic have tried to ​maintain a more open research culture to both ⁠attract employees and foster creativity that can lead to breakthroughs. The AI field is rooted in academia, where machine-learning scientists have openly discussed their research.

Some OpenAI employees are increasingly worried about this approach as AI grows more capable, according to the five people.
